senses.sense_definition: A person who is fanatically committed to a particular cause, religion, or belief.

examples.text: The political <w>zealot</w> refused to listen to any differing opinions during the debate.
He was labeled a religious <w>zealot</w> because of his extreme views and uncompromising attitude.

senses.sense_definition: A member of an ancient Jewish sect that fiercely opposed Roman rule in Judea.

examples.text: The <w>Zealot</w> faction advocated armed rebellion to drive Roman forces out of Judea.
Historians study how each <w>Zealot</w> resisted imperial authorities during the first century.

senses.sense_definition: A member of an anti-aristocratic political faction that governed Thessalonica from 1342 to 1350.

examples.text: During the uprising, a prominent <w>Zealot</w> led the seizure of aristocratic estates in Thessalonica.
Every local <w>Zealot</w> joined the fight against the nobility during the fourteenth-century rebellion.
